Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 18  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Pasquale Festa Campanile (born 1927) was older than Bill Rebane (born 1937), and thus determined that "The Gamecock" had the older director. However, the task explicitly asks for which *film* has the director who is older, not which director is older. The Planner failed to account for the fact that "Monster A-Go-Go" was released in 1965, while "The Gamecock" was released in 1974. At the time of their respective film releases, Bill Rebane (born in 1937) would have been 28 years old, while Pasquale Festa Campanile (born in 1927) would have been 47 years old. Therefore, the correct answer should have been "Monster A-Go-Go" since Bill Rebane was older at the time of his film's release than Pasquale Festa Campanile was at the time of his film's release. The Planner's oversight of the importance of the release years led to the incorrect conclusion.
